race.description: Melbourne Cup Day At Bunbury On Sale Mdn
race.comment: DYNASTIC LASS (11) crossed from a wide draw and just missed two back at Northam before being 1.4L off the winner here most recently. Should find the front again from an inside draw and she remains down in the weights. The blinkers and Pike are big ticks, and she can get the job done this time. PLAYA DEL SOL (5) brings the next clearest race form after running second to Pistone at this venue, and her Belmont Park fifth two back was also sound. Out in trip now is ideal and it wouldn't surprise to see her go one better this time around. ROCK ROYALTY (10) is the most interesting debutant, being a full brother to G3 winner Red Sun Sensation, with a close Belmont Park trial under his belt. Looks suited to this trip fresh and he can play a leading role. ZALI'S GIFT (4) is ticking along nicely without winning and has claims from a better barrier today. ARRESTEDEVELOPMENT (9) trialled well recently and has to come into calculations.
